_comment: How every edge function with verify_jwt = false authenticates its callers. The API gateway lets
these requests through unauthenticated, so the function itself is the only thing between the
internet and a service-role client. check-edge-function-auth.mjs requires an entry here for each
one, and requires each declared gate to still be reachable in that function's import closure.
Gates listed are the function's OWN inbound check; a marker reachable only through a shared
helper it imports for another purpose is deliberately not declared.

analyze-state-form.rationale: Dual surface: the document-analyzer cron sweep (pg_net, no JWT) and a platform_admin 'process this upload now' kick, whose JWT is verified inside the function.

dispatch-integration-webhooks.rationale: Internal cron worker. The signing code it imports produces OUTBOUND signatures for the webhooks it delivers; it is not an inbound gate.

dispatch-notifications.rationale: Internal cron worker that drains the notification queue.

email-savings-model.rationale: Public marketing form; a Cloudflare Turnstile token is required before anything is sent.

evidence-guest-download.rationale: Reviewers and inspectors have no account. The per-grant token IS the credential and is validated against evidence_guest_grants.

fhir-ingest.rationale: Connected EHR/pharmacy systems present a Phase 2 integration API credential in the Authorization header; unknown or revoked credentials get 401.

fhir-writeback.rationale: Cron-only outbound drain. Its crypto imports sign the requests it makes to the remote FHIR server.

generate-certificate-pdf.rationale: Dual surface: the PDF-job cron worker, and authenticated user downloads whose JWT is verified inside the function.

generate-compliance-binder.rationale: Dual surface: the binder-export cron worker, and authenticated user downloads/enqueues verified inside the function.

get-platform-status.rationale: Deliberately public: the signup page and the pre-auth maintenance banner need to know whether signups are open before any session exists. Reads platform_settings with the service-role client but returns only two curated booleans, never the row.

integration-api.rationale: Partner-facing API. Callers present a Phase 2 integration credential in the Authorization header.

poll-heygen-video-statuses.rationale: Internal cron worker polling video render status.

poll-regulatory-updates.rationale: Internal cron worker fetching regulatory source pages.

process-data-import-jobs.rationale: Internal cron worker that claims durable data-import jobs so a closed browser tab cannot strand one in 'applying'.

process-organization-export-jobs.rationale: Internal cron worker draining the organization export queue.

provision-demo-tenant.rationale: One-off ops action run as a deploy step, authorized by x-demo-provision-secret with an inline constant-time compare over SHA-256 digests rather than a signed-in admin.

report-client-error.rationale: Deliberately public: browser error telemetry has to be reportable when the session is exactly what is broken. Bounded by method and body-size checks and PHI-scrubbed before storage; both behaviours are covered by its runtime tests.

request-demo.rationale: Public marketing form gated by a Cloudflare Turnstile token.

resident-portal-download.rationale: A resident's designated person has no account; the portal grant token is validated on every call, the same surface the portal RPCs expose to anon.

run-data-lifecycle.rationale: Internal cron worker running archival and purge sweeps. Authorization is injectable for tests but defaults to the shared cron check.

scim-provision.rationale: Identity-provider SCIM endpoint. The bearer credential is hashed and compared constant-time against the stored connection credential.

send-auth-email.rationale: Supabase Auth send-email hook. Authenticity is the Standard Webhooks signature over SEND_EMAIL_HOOK_SECRET; verify_jwt cannot apply because Auth itself is the caller.

send-regulatory-digest.rationale: Internal cron worker. It mints unsubscribe tokens for the emails it sends; that is outbound content, not an inbound gate.

sendgrid-notification-webhook.rationale: SendGrid event webhook, verified with SendGrid's ECDSA event-webhook signature before any row is written.

signup-organization.rationale: Public self-serve signup gated by a Cloudflare Turnstile token.

stripe-billing-webhook.rationale: Stripe webhook, verified against the stripe-signature header before the event is processed.

submit-confidential-intake.rationale: Confidential reporting intake, reachable by a reporter with no account and gated by a Turnstile token; reporter identity is stored separately from the intake.

subscribe-updates.rationale: Public newsletter signup gated by a Turnstile token. It also mints an unsubscribe token, which is outbound.

sync-billing-quantities.rationale: Internal cron worker enforcing flat qty=1 and syncing metered quantities to Stripe; its Stripe client is an outbound credential.

twilio-notification-webhook.rationale: Twilio status webhook, verified with Twilio's request signature over the full URL and parameters.

unsubscribe-updates.rationale: One-click unsubscribe from an email footer; the per-subscriber unsubscribe_token is the credential. Oracle-free -- the same page is returned whether or not the token matched.

process-credential-renewals.rationale: Dual surface: OCR cron worker (pg_net, no JWT) and platform_admin kick whose JWT is verified inside the function.

survey-packet-guest-download.rationale: Surveyors and inspectors download packaged survey evidence with a per-grant token; no account. The token is validated via resolve_survey_packet_guest_token (service-role).
